build/editorial/L09.json.kicker.en: For rent · Exclusive · Nofei Yam, north Tel Aviv
build/editorial/L09.json.dek.en: A mini penthouse on a high floor in Nofei Yam: five rooms on 135 sqm, three master suites, and two balconies, one of them facing the sea. The rent is given on direct request.
build/editorial/L09.json.story.en[0]: A five-room mini penthouse, three of the rooms master suites, on 135 sqm built with a 20 sqm balcony, on a high floor of a luxury building in Nofei Yam.[[IG_L09A,IG_L09B]] It has two balconies, one of them facing the sea, and the apartment keeps its privacy.[[IG_L09A,IG_L09D]]
build/editorial/L09.json.story.en[1]: The apartment was designed by an architect, with quality parquet throughout, a luxury kitchen and custom carpentry.[[IG_L09E]]
build/editorial/L09.json.story.en[2]: Two separate parking spaces prepared for electric-car charging and an attached storage room, and the building has a gym and a guard.[[IG_L09D,IG_L09C]] The rent and the building details are given on direct request.
build/editorial/L09.json.building_lead.en: The building details, the year it was built and the building fee are given on direct request.[[IG_L09C]]
build/editorial/L09.json.building[2].dd.en: 6 to 11 floors in the Nofei Yam listings reviewed; a 30-floor tower is under construction on Einstein Street
build/editorial/L09.json.location.en[0]: The coastal park promenade opened in September 2023 and runs about 2 km along the cliff, from Tel Baruch beach in the south to Tzuk beach in the north, inside a 500-dunam nature park and alongside a bike path.[[WALLA_PROM,TIMEOUT_PROM]] Content published by Globes describes Nofei Yam as a short walk from the beach.[[GLOBES_NY_2024]]
build/editorial/L09.json.numbers.lead.en: The rent is given on direct request. The figures here are based on similar listings in Nofei Yam and Lamed HaHadasha, the 2026 arnona rates and the Fair Rental Law rules.
build/editorial/L09.json.numbers.tabs[0].rows[1].note.en: From 135 sqm without the balcony at the zone 2 newest-code rate, to 155 sqm including the balcony at the zone 1 over-140 sqm rate. Zone, code and charged area to be confirmed
build/editorial/L09.json.market.h2.en: Large homes for rent in Nofei Yam and Lamed HaHadasha
build/editorial/L09.json.faq[0].a.en: The rent is given on direct request. Based on similar listings in Nofei Yam and Lamed HaHadasha, the market range for 135 sqm is about NIS 15,500 to 20,250 a month, before arnona and the building fee. This is a computation, not a quote.[[MAD_TXCK,MAD_SDOT]]
build/editorial/L09.json.faq[1].a.en: Entry is flexible, and the date is agreed directly with Meital Katzir.[[IG_L09D]]
build/editorial/L09.json.faq[2].a.en: The building has a gym and a guard. The hours of the guard and what the building fee covers are given on request.[[IG_L09C]]
build/editorial/L09.json.faq[4].a.en: The parking spaces are prepared for charging. The installation and electricity details are given on request.[[IG_L09D]]

build/editorial/L10.json.kicker.en: For rent · Exclusive · Nofei Yam, north Tel Aviv
build/editorial/L10.json.dek.en: On floor 5 of a low building in Nofei Yam, about five minutes on foot from the sea: three rooms on about 90 sqm with a balcony of about 20 sqm facing an open area, a safe room, two parking spaces and a large storage room. NIS 9,500 a month.
build/editorial/L10.json.story.en[0]: Three rooms on about 90 sqm, a balcony of about 20 sqm facing an open area, and a safe room, on floor 5 of a seven-floor building on pillars with a lift.[[MAD_L10]] Two separate parking spaces and a large storage room by the parking, and the sea about five minutes on foot, next to the walking path.[[IG_L10,MAD_L10]]
build/editorial/L10.json.story.en[1]: The rent is NIS 9,500 a month, with entry on 1 October 2026 and flexibility on the date.[[IG_L10,MAD_L10]]
build/editorial/L10.json.story.en[2]: Nofei Yam is the neighborhood between Propes Street to the north, Levi Eshkol Boulevard to the east, Einstein Street to the south and the Sde Dov area to the west, and together with Ramat Aviv HaHadasha it forms HaGush HaGadol.[[PTLV_NY,HON_RAH]] It holds about 2,000 apartments in relatively low buildings, because of the height limits from the days of the airport.[[GLOBES_NY_2024]]
build/editorial/L10.json.features.en[4][1]: The coastal park promenade opened in 2023[[WALLA_PROM]]
build/editorial/L10.json.building_lead.en: The year built, the number of apartments and the management arrangements for the building are given on request.[[IG_L10,MAD_L10]]
build/editorial/L10.json.building[2].dd.en: 6 to 11 floors in the Nofei Yam listings reviewed; a 30-floor tower is under construction on Einstein Street
build/editorial/L10.json.schools_override[0].note.en: About 91 pupils per grade. Registration zone to be confirmed.
build/editorial/L10.json.schools_override[1].note.en: Listed as a nearby school for Nofei Yam addresses. Registration zone to be confirmed.
build/editorial/L10.json.schools_override[2].note.en: A new building on the northern extension of Ibn Gabirol Street at Marc Chagall Street; seven classes plus a special education class per grade. In January 2025 construction was being completed. Registration zone to be confirmed.
build/editorial/L10.json.transport_override[1].status.en: Planned along Einstein Street, with a sunken station at the Namir and Einstein junction and a station near Marc Chagall Street. The works schedule on Einstein Street is to be confirmed.
build/editorial/L10.json.future_override[0].impact.en: A 30-floor tower with 180 homes on Einstein Street, the neighborhood's southern edge, with completion expected in mid-2028. Until then, expect construction work and site traffic nearby. The distance from the building depends on the exact address.[[PTLV_NY]]
build/editorial/L10.json.future_override[1].impact.en: 179 apartments. Construction was planned to start in 2025, per content published in Globes in 2024; the current status is to be confirmed.
build/editorial/L10.json.numbers.lead.en: The rent, computed against the 2026 arnona rates and the Fair Rental Law rules.
build/editorial/L10.json.numbers.tabs[0].rows[1].note.en: 110 sqm including the balcony, at newest-code rates for zone 2 to zone 1; lower for older building codes. Zone, code and charged area to be confirmed
build/editorial/L10.json.market.where_override.rent:4.en: Tzukei Aviv, new boutique building, furnished, with an existing tenancy
build/editorial/L10.json.faq[0].a.en: NIS 9,500. With arnona as estimated, and before the building fee, which is given on request, about NIS 10,332 to 10,536 a month.[[IG_L10,G_KH_TLV]]
build/editorial/L10.json.faq[1].a.en: About 90 sqm plus a balcony of about 20 sqm, on floor 5 of a seven-floor building on pillars with a lift.[[MAD_L10]]
build/editorial/L10.json.faq[2].a.en: Yes. The apartment has a safe room, two separate parking spaces and a large storage room by the parking.[[IG_L10,MAD_L10]]
build/editorial/L10.json.faq[3].a.en: About five minutes on foot, next to the path to the sea. The coastal park promenade, about 2 km from Tel Baruch beach to Tzuk beach, opened in 2023.[[IG_L10,WALLA_PROM]]

build/editorial/L11.json.kicker.en: For rent · Exclusive · Ramat Aviv, north Tel Aviv
build/editorial/L11.json.dek.en: A five-room apartment on a high floor, in a Ramat Aviv complex with a swimming pool, a gym and a guard. Two parking spaces and a storage room. The rent and the name of the complex are given on direct request.
build/editorial/L11.json.story.en[0]: A spacious, bright five-room apartment on a high floor, in a quality Ramat Aviv complex with a swimming pool, a gym, a guard and other services. It comes with two parking spaces and a storage room.[[IG_L11]]
build/editorial/L11.json.story.en[1]: The name of the complex, the floor and the exact area are given on direct request.
build/editorial/L11.json.building_lead.en: The name of the complex and the address are given on request. Alongside the services are cost examples from buildings with similar services nearby.[[IG_L11]]
build/editorial/L11.json.numbers.lead.en: The rent and the area are given on direct request. The figures here are based on five-room listings in Ramat Aviv HaHadasha and Ramat Aviv Gimel, building fee examples from complexes with a pool, and the 2026 arnona rates.
build/editorial/L11.json.numbers.tabs[0].rows[1].note.en: NIS 15 to 17 per sqm in examples from buildings with a pool, assuming 130 to 140 sqm; the area of this apartment is given on request
build/editorial/L11.json.numbers.tabs[0].rows[2].note.en: Assuming 140 sqm including balconies, at newest-code rates for zone 2 to zone 1; area, zone and code to be confirmed
build/editorial/L11.json.schools_override[4].note.en: A new building on the northern extension of Ibn Gabirol Street at Marc Chagall Street; seven classes plus a special education class per grade. Registration zone to be confirmed.
build/editorial/L11.json.transport_override[1].status.en: Planned along Namir Road, Einstein Street and Haim Levanon Street, with a sunken station at the Namir and Einstein junction. The works schedule is to be confirmed.
build/editorial/L11.json.transport_override[2].status.en: Station names include Tel Aviv University, Brodetsky and Namir. Order and exact locations to be confirmed.

Five-room units in Ramat Aviv HaHadasha and Ramat Aviv Gimel are offered at NIS 12,800 to 18,000 a month, and a building with a pool adds a building fee of about NIS 1,700 to 2,300, based on examples nearby.[[MAD_V6WX,MAD_KSOP,MAD_QYSY]]
